plugins.name: tdpilot
plugins.description: Build, debug, and verify TouchDesigner networks by talking to your AI. TDPilot gives the agent live control of a running TD session: it creates and wires operators, sets real parameter values, screenshots the render to verify its own work, and can transactionally roll back anything it did. Grounded in a full operator-knowledge atlas, guarded by snapshots, undo, and an activity log. Run /td-first-wow after install for a moving visual in under two minutes. Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and any MCP client — no signup, no API key.
